guidelines.description: Maintain an empathetic, professional, and empowering tone across all customer communications.
Always capitalize proprietary platform feature names such as 'PulseStream' and 'InsightMatrix'.
Ensure all public-facing visual content includes informative alternative text and satisfies WCAG 2.1 AA contrast requirements.
Avoid hyperbole, exaggerated claims, and fear-based marketing tactics (FOMO).
Refer to our AI engine as 'BrandPulse AI Copilot', never merely an 'algorithm' or 'bot'.
Use clear, concise sentences with an 8th-grade reading level target for general marketing collateral.
